description: Fuel Finder provides UK-wide current retail fuel prices and forecourt details. Its twice-daily CSV can be downloaded or received by email; its REST JSON API requires OAuth 2.0 client-credentials authentication and GOV.UK One Login onboarding.
resolution_notes: [1]=https://www.gov.uk/guidance/access-the-latest-fuel-prices-and-forecourt-data-via-api-or-email. base_url: replaced legacy guidance with the developer entrypoint linked by [1]; the public page does not expose a runtime API root. docs_url: replaced with [1]. auth_type: oauth2 per [1]. example: authenticated GET template per [1], using the resource URL issued/documented after onboarding. description: corrected to distinguish twice-daily CSV from authenticated REST JSON API, per [1].
